assessment_convention: Baseline descriptions report an axis rather than a deciphered reading direction. POSSIBLE_UNBOUND records a locally imaginable transition where an inner inscription broadly follows the nearby annular tangent; it does not favor that interpretation over a standalone inscription. SEPARATED_NO_CUE records the clearer change of orientation and intervening space for the radial inscriptions. Neither verdict rules out an implicit jump or reset; stroke contact is not required.
